review.notes: Full token-level pass of all 15 physical PDF pages; physical pages 1, 3, 5 and 7 were rendered and visually checked. All seven printed footnote bodies (five URLs and two prose notes) were dropped while their superscript markers survived, and one garbled word was found ('redeaming' for the printed 'redteaming'). Remaining token deltas are soft-hyphen splits and hyphenated reference names that the markdown joins correctly (Cancedda, O'Connell, Ruddit all present).
